This reed is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in south-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

Sheep's Plume stalks are used to brew a medicinal decoction. A dose restores 2–20 concussion hits. The marshes and freshwater banks where this reed grows are the most plausible places to seek it; its effect requires the prescribed preparation.
